fields.address: Địa chỉ nhận thư của JuniSprouts / KT Novelty LLC: 8790 FM 1960 Bypass, Humble, TX 77338, Hoa Kỳ. Chưa xác nhận đây là điểm nhận hàng trực tiếp.
fields.payment: Footer website JuniSprouts hiển thị các phương thức: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, JCB, Maestro, UnionPay và PayPal (kiểm tra ngày 2026-10-29). Phương thức khả dụng cho đơn cụ thể cần xem tại checkout https://junisprouts.com/. Chưa có căn cứ cam kết COD, chuyển khoản ngân hàng hay MoMo.
fields.returns: Theo trang chính sách riêng: trong 60 ngày từ khi nhận, hàng mới/chưa dùng, đủ bộ và bao bì gốc. Email support@junisprouts.com kèm mã đơn trước khi gửi trả; nhận hướng dẫn và địa chỉ trả từ hỗ trợ. Khách chịu phí gửi trả; phí giao ban đầu không hoàn. Hoàn tiền sau kiểm tra, thường 5–10 ngày làm việc, về phương thức gốc hoặc store credit. Gift card, hàng final-sale/clearance, hàng đã chơi không đủ điều kiện. Trang sản phẩm có đoạn 90 ngày mâu thuẫn; cần chủ shop xác nhận.
fields.shipping: Theo chính sách JuniSprouts: chỉ giao trong 50 bang Hoa Kỳ, chưa giao quốc tế. Thường xử lý trong 12 giờ. USPS/UPS, dự kiến 3–7 ngày làm việc sau xử lý, không bảo đảm ngày đến. Phí tiêu chuẩn 8.99 USD; miễn phí với đơn trên 49.99 USD. Alaska/Hawaii có thể lâu hơn. Tracking gửi qua email. Chính sách vẫn niêm yết USD dù catalog đang hiển thị VND; chưa quy đổi phí vận chuyển.
fields.warranty: Chưa tìm thấy thời hạn bảo hành riêng. Nếu hàng hỏng, lỗi hoặc giao sai, gửi email support@junisprouts.com trong 30 ngày kèm ảnh. Không tự hứa hoàn tiền hoặc đổi mới trước khi bộ phận hỗ trợ xác nhận.
fields.promotion: Website mời đăng ký email để nhận ưu đãi 10% cho đơn đầu. Chưa xác minh mã, thời hạn hay khả năng cộng dồn; không tự áp dụng hoặc cam kết ưu đãi khác.

profile.notes:
Bộ dữ liệu thử nghiệm cho TinyMind lấy từ JuniSprouts (https://junisprouts.com/), cửa hàng đồ chơi gỗ lấy cảm hứng Montessori cho trẻ nhỏ, do KT Novelty LLC vận hành tại Humble, Texas. Email hỗ trợ công khai: support@junisprouts.com; trang Contact ghi phản hồi trong 1–2 ngày làm việc. Bán từng món, không subscription. Catalog VND được lấy trực tiếp từ phiên website hiển thị VND ngày 2026-10-29; chính sách phí ship bằng USD giữ nguyên. Không suy ra có giao Việt Nam từ việc hiển thị VND. Chưa xác minh hotline, Zalo, Google Maps, phương thức thanh toán áp dụng cho từng đơn, số lượng tồn kho thực tế hoặc địa điểm nhận trực tiếp. Luôn theo tuổi khuyến nghị và cảnh báo tại trang chi tiết; người lớn giám sát khi chơi.
Tồn kho mẫu do chủ shop duyệt ngày 2026-10-29: mỗi sản phẩm tổng Có thể bán 10, bộ thực phẩm có 5 biến thể mỗi loại 2. Đây là số lượng demo để thử tạo đơn, không phải số lượng thực tế tại JuniSprouts; khi có đơn phải dùng tồn kho hiện tại trong ứng dụng.

settings.mission: Tư vấn đồ chơi gỗ và Montessori cho khách của TinyMind bằng dữ liệu JuniSprouts đã được nhập. Hỏi tuổi của bé, sở thích, nhu cầu và ngân sách; gợi ý phù hợp tuổi và lưu ý chi tiết nhỏ. Chỉ nói giá và chính sách có nguồn. Khi khách muốn đặt hàng, tóm tắt đúng sản phẩm/biến thể, xin thông tin cần thiết và chuyển cho chủ shop xác nhận; không tự hứa đã tạo đơn, giữ hàng hoặc thu tiền.
settings.greeting: Dạ, TinyMind chào anh/chị! Anh/chị đang tìm đồ chơi cho bé bao nhiêu tuổi ạ?

products.name: Wooden Flame Stacking Puzzle
products.searchNameVi: Bộ xếp hình ngọn lửa gỗ
products.ageRecommendation: 4 years and up, with light adult supervision as needed.
products.description: Glowing, flame-shaped pieces nest and stack into endless open-ended creations — a beautiful, heirloom-quality puzzle made to be handed down. It's one of our favorite Waldorf-inspired toys . Crafted as a wooden Montessori toy should be, each piece is smooth natural wood with soft, warm color and no single right way to play. Nesting, stacking, and arranging the flames builds fine motor skills , balance, creativity, and early problem-solving through calm, self-directed play. A screen-free educational toy for toddlers and preschoolers, it grows with your child from simple puzzles to imaginative loose-parts play. Gift-ready and built to last, it's a considered birthday or holiday present. Adult supervision is recommended, as it contains small parts. Smart play for little growing minds.
products.detailFacts: About This Toy Glowing, flame-shaped pieces nest and stack into endless open-ended creations — a beautiful, heirloom-quality puzzle made to be handed down. It's one of our favorite Waldorf-inspired toys.Crafted as a wooden Montessori toy should be, each piece is smooth natural wood with soft, warm color and no single right way to play. Nesting, stacking, and arranging the flames builds fine motor skills, balance, creativity, and early problem-solving through calm, self-directed play. A screen-free educational toy for toddlers and preschoolers, it grows with your child from simple puzzles to imaginative loose-parts play. Gift-ready and built to last, it's a considered birthday or holiday present. Adult supervision is recommended, as it contains small parts. Smart play for little growing minds. Highlights Materials: Solid wood with a soft, non-toxic water-based color wash; the natural wood grain is left visible through the finish in classic Waldorf style.Total pieces: 5 wooden flame-shaped nesting pieces in graduated sizes.Approximate dimensions: Roughly 16–17 cm tall × 12–13 cm wide when fully nested. A lap-sized, shelf-friendly piece.Finish: Soft color wash over natural wood — each piece shows unique grain markings, dark spots, and natural variations that are part of the toy's character, not defects.Assembly: None — ready to play straight from the box. No batteries needed.Power: No batteries, no electronics, no screens — purely open-ended, screen-free play.Safety: Adult supervision recommended. Not suitable for children under 3 due to smaller pieces. Please review all product details before purchase.Care: Wipe gently with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Do not submerge in water, run through a dishwasher, or use harsh cleaners. Store in a dry place away from direct sunlight to preserve color and finish. Age & Stages Recommended age: 4 years and up, with light adult supervision as needed.Ages 3–4: With close adult supervision, younger preschoolers enjoy exploring the larger outer pieces and discovering how they fit together. Smaller pieces are best held back at this stage.Ages 4–5: First independent nesting and stacking. Children begin solving the puzzle on their own and arranging the pieces as separate arches.Ages 5–6: Creative builds emerge — standing the pieces on edge as bridges and tunnels, combining them with other loose parts, and inventing pretend-play scenes.Ages 6+: Storytelling and architecture. Older children incorporate the flame pieces into larger imaginative scenes — campfires, dragons, sunrise scenes — alongside other open-ended toys.Important supervision note: Not recommended for children under 3, as the smaller pieces may present a choking hazard. Light adult supervision is recommended during early play, especially with the smallest inner ember piece. Development Skills at Play Fine motor skills: Lifting, rotating, and fitting each curved piece back into the next gives little hands focused, repeatable practice that strengthens coordination and grip.Hand-eye coordination: Aligning each flame layer with the one above it builds the precise eye-and-hand connections children rely on for years to come.Spatial reasoning: Discovering which piece fits inside which — and rotating them to find the right orientation — gently introduces geometry and three-dimensional thinking.Color recognition: Five graduated warm-color tones (yellow, orange, red, crimson, dark ember) give children a calm, hands-on reference for naming and sorting colors.Open-ended creativity: With no fixed "right answer," each play session unfolds differently — a nested flame today, a row of arches tomorrow, a tunnel scene the day after.Balance & early engineering: Standing the pieces on edge as separate arches teaches the joy and patience of careful, intentional building.Imaginative storytelling: The flame shape invites pretend play — a campfire, a sunrise, a dragon's breath, a small cave for tiny figures.Patience and focus: Solving the nesting puzzle builds the kind of quiet, sustained attention children carry into school and beyond. What's Included 5 wooden flame-shaped nesting pieces in graduated sizes, each cut from solid woodColors from largest to smallest: bright yellow, orange, red, deep crimson, and a small dark inner ember pieceAll 5 pieces nest together as one complete flame shape when storedStained wood finish with the natural grain visible through a soft color wash, in classic Waldorf style FAQ Q: What age is this flame puzzle best for?A: It's recommended for ages 4 and up, though older preschoolers (3–4) can enjoy the larger pieces with close adult supervision. The open-ended design means it continues to be loved well into the early school years.Q: How many pieces are included?A: Five wooden flame-shaped pieces in graduated sizes — bright yellow, orange, red, deep crimson, and a small dark inner ember piece — that all nest together as one complete flame.Q: Is this similar to the Grimm's Fire stacker?A: Yes — this is a Waldorf-inspired flame puzzle in the same tradition as Grimm's classic Elements: Fire stacker. The 5-piece nesting design and soft color-washed wood finish encourage the same kind of open-ended, imaginative play.Q: How big is the puzzle?A: Approximately 16–17 cm tall when fully nested — a substantial, lap-sized piece that's also lovely to display on a shelf or windowsill when not in use.Q: What is it made of?A: Solid wood finished with a soft, non-toxic water-based color wash. The natural wood grain shows through the finish, giving each piece its own unique character.Q: What can my child do with it besides nesting?A: Lots! Children stand the pieces on edge as a row of arches, use them as bridges and tunnels for small figures, line them up as a backdrop for pretend play, or simply admire the flame shape as a small piece of natural-wood art on their shelf.Q: Is it safe for toddlers under 3?A: We don't recommend this set for children under 3, as the smaller inner pieces may present a choking hazard. If older siblings play with it nearby, the smallest pieces should be stored out of reach.Q: Does this make a good gift?A: Yes — it's a thoughtful, heirloom-quality gift for preschoolers and older children. The open-ended design grows with the child and is loved equally by parents and Waldorf or Montessori educators.

products.name: Wooden 6-in-1 Activity Cube
products.searchNameVi: Khối hoạt động gỗ 6 trong 1
products.ageRecommendation: 1 year and up, with close adult supervision at all times.
products.description: Six sides of hands-on discovery in one beautifully made wooden cube. Shape sorting, color matching, a spinning drum, an ABC puzzle, and more give busy toddlers plenty to explore — which is why it's one of our favorite Montessori toys for 1 year old hands and up. As a wooden educational toy , it's screen-free and battery-free, with a smooth natural finish and a handy storage drawer to keep the smaller pieces tidy. Each activity supports a real skill: shape recognition, early letters and colors, and the kind of focused, self-directed play the Montessori approach is built around, all while strengthening fine motor skills . Compact enough for a shelf yet rich enough to return to daily, it makes a wonderful gift for toddlers — ideal for a first birthday or the holidays. Adult supervision is recommended, as the set includes small parts. Smart play for little growing minds.

All loose pieces store neatly in the built-in drawer.Finish: Smooth, lightly polished wood surfaces with hand-painted color accents in a soft, modern palette.Power: No batteries, no electronics, no screens — purely mechanical, screen-free play.Safety: Contains small parts. Please review all product details before purchase.Care: Wipe gently with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Avoid soaking, dishwashers, or harsh cleaners. Store in a dry place away from direct sunlight to preserve color and finish. Age & Stages Recommended age: 1 year and up, with close adult supervision at all times.Ages 1–2: First exploration. Babies enjoy spinning the rainbow drum, pushing the colored sticks, and watching adults drop shapes with delighted curiosity.Ages 2–3: Independent shape sorting and color matching. Toddlers begin naming the colors, matching shapes to slots, and pulling pieces out of the storage drawer themselves.Ages 3–4: Letter recognition emerges. Preschoolers name the ABC letters, sort by color and shape independently, and invent their own little play routines.Ages 4+: Self-directed play. Older children love demonstrating each activity to younger siblings and creating their own sorting challenges.Important supervision note: This cube includes small parts — the color coins, ABC letter pieces, shape sorter pieces, and pull-through sticks — that present a potential choking hazard. Adult supervision is required during play, especially for children under 3. Always store small pieces in the drawer or out of reach when the toy is not in active, supervised use. Development Skills at Play Fine motor skills: Gripping shapes, dropping coins, pushing sticks through holes, and lifting letter pieces give little hands focused, repeatable practice that strengthens coordination and grip.Hand-eye coordination: Matching each shape, coin, and letter to its correct slot builds the precise eye-and-hand connections children rely on for years to come.Shape recognition: Three classic geometric shapes (circle, square, triangle) give toddlers a calm, hands-on reference for naming and matching shapes.Color recognition: Labeled color slots (Red, Cyan, Green) plus rainbow coins and sticks introduce color names and sorting in a clear, intuitive way.Letter recognition: The ABC letter puzzle on the front panel introduces the first three letters of the alphabet through hands-on play, not screens.Cause and effect: Spinning the rainbow drum, watching coins drop, and pushing sticks through to the other side teach the satisfying lesson that little actions create big reactions.Sorting & matching: Every side of the cube invites a sorting decision — which shape, which color, which letter — building early logical thinking.Focus and screen-free play: With six different activities in one compact cube, toddlers stay engaged for longer stretches — the kind of focused play that grows attention spans. Younger babies enjoy the rainbow drum and pull-through sticks with adult help, while older toddlers and preschoolers grow into the shape sorter, color coins, and ABC puzzle.Q: How many activities does the cube have?A: Six built-in activities on a single compact cube: a shape sorter, a color-coin sorter with labeled slots, an ABC letter puzzle, a detachable rainbow drum, six pull-through colored sticks, and a slide-out 'Zing Zoo' animal puzzle card.Q: Is it safe for my 1-year-old?A: This set contains small parts — the color coins, ABC letter pieces, shape sorter pieces, and pull-through sticks — that present a potential choking hazard. Adult supervision is required at all times. For very young toddlers, we recommend letting them explore the rainbow drum and pull-through sticks while keeping the smaller pieces close by your hand.Q: How big is the cube?A: The cube measures 24.5 × 13.3 × 12.5 cm (9.6 × 5.2 × 4.9 inches) — a substantial, sit-on-the-floor size that's still easy to carry between rooms.Q: Does it require batteries?A: No — there are no batteries, electronics, or screens. Every activity is purely mechanical, designed for calm, screen-free play.Q: Can all the pieces be stored inside?A: Yes — the pull-out yellow drawer on the front holds all the loose pieces (shapes, coins, letters, and sticks), keeping the toy tidy and travel-friendly.Q: What is the cube made of?A: Solid wood with a smooth, child-friendly painted finish and printed paper graphics on the side panels. The hand-painted accents use a soft, modern color palette designed to look at home in any playroom or nursery.Q: Does this make a good gift?A: Yes — with six activities packed into a single compact cube, it's a thoughtful, long-lasting first-birthday or baby-shower gift that grows with the child from first exploration through the early preschool years.

A: Five variants: Knife Set, Fruit Set, Vegetable Set, Meat Set, and Bread & Bakery Set. Each ships in its own natural wooden crate for storage.Q: Do I need the Knife Set to cut the food? A: The food sets are lovely on their own for pretend cooking and sorting play, but yes — the Knife Set is what unlocks the satisfying slicing experience. Most families pair the Knife Set with one or more food sets to start, then add more food sets over time.Q: How do the food pieces 'cut' in half? A: Each cuttable food piece is joined by a small embedded magnet. Children gently press down with the wooden knife, the pieces separate cleanly, and they snap back together with a satisfying click to play again.Q: Are the magnets safe? A: The magnets are securely embedded inside the wooden pieces. However, magnets can cause serious internal injury if swallowed, so adult supervision is required and all pieces should be kept away from children under 3 and from pets. Inspect pieces regularly and remove any damaged piece immediately.Q: What is the toy made of? A: Natural wood with smooth, child-friendly painted finishes, plus small embedded magnets in each cuttable food piece and metal utensil heads (knife, cleaver, spatula) with wooden handles.Q: What skills does this toy support? A: It's designed to support fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, pretend play, language development, food recognition, social play, and real-life kitchen vocabulary.Q: Does this make a good gift? A: Absolutely. The soft palette, sturdy build, and beautiful wooden crate make each set a thoughtful pretend-play gift for birthdays, holidays, or any little chef-in-training.

Clapper 12 cm × 2 cm.Finish: Smooth, lightly polished wood surfaces and soft painted accents in warm, neutral tones — designed for comfortable handling and gentle, lasting useAssembly: No assembly, no tools, and no batteries required — ready to play straight out of the traySafety: Designed with small-children safety in mind. Age & Stages Recommended age: 3 years and up, with adult supervision recommendedAges 3–4: First explorations — discovering each instrument, learning which sound comes from which piece, and joyful free-play.Ages 4–5: Children begin copying simple rhythms, identifying loud and soft sounds, and inventing their own little songs.Ages 5+: Older children enjoy putting on small concerts, playing along with music, and using the set in cooperative play with siblings or friends.Important supervision note: This set contains small parts and pieces with cords (such as the castanets and bell stick). Adult supervision is recommended during play, and all pieces should be stored out of reach of younger siblings under 3. Development Skills at Play Fine motor skills: Gripping mallets, squeezing castanets, and shaking the maraca all give little hands gentle, repeated practice.Hand-eye coordination: Striking a xylophone key or tapping the triangle helps connect what the eyes see with what the hands do.Auditory development: Each instrument offers a different sound — bright, soft, ringing, jingling — encouraging careful listening and early pitch awareness.Cause and effect: Every shake, tap, and strike rewards a child with a sound, building the simple "I did that" connection that's central to Montessori-inspired play.Rhythm and timing: Repeating beats and copying simple patterns supports early musical thinking and pre-math sequencing skills.Creative expression: With no right or wrong way to play, the set encourages open-ended exploration and self-expression.Focus and patience: Choosing one instrument, exploring its sound, then moving to the next supports quiet attention and self-paced play.Social play: Perfect for sibling jam sessions, family sing-alongs, or small group play in preschool and daycare settings. What's Included 1 wooden xylophone with eight painted keys in soft natural tones2 wooden mallets for the xylophone1 wooden tambourine with metal jingles1 metal triangle with yellow-tipped striker1 wooden bell stick with multiple metal jingle bells1 striped wooden maraca1 wooden rainmaker with colorful flower-shaped beads1 set of wooden castanets with elastic finger loop1 wooden clapper paddle1 natural wood display and storage tray FAQ Q: What age is this music set best for? A: It's recommended for ages 3 and up. Most preschoolers love exploring real instrument sounds, and older children enjoy inventing rhythms and small concerts.Q: Is it safe for younger toddlers under 3? A: The set contains small parts and pieces with cords, so we recommend keeping it for ages 3 and up. Younger siblings should only handle pieces with close adult supervision, or stick to the larger, simpler instruments under a parent's watchful eye.Q: What instruments are included in the set? A: Ten pieces in total — a wooden xylophone, two mallets, a tambourine, a triangle and striker, a bell stick, a maraca, a rainmaker, castanets, a clapper, and a wooden display tray for storage.Q: What is the set made of? A: A combination of natural beech wood, soft-painted wood, metal jingles and bells, and a clear acrylic tube for the rainmaker. The display tray is also made of natural wood.Q: What skills does this set support? A: It's designed to support fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, auditory development, rhythm and timing, cause-and-effect understanding, and creative self-expression — all through screen-free play.Q: Is it loud? A: The instruments are designed for child play, so the sounds are real but gentle — softer than full-sized adult instruments. The xylophone, triangle, and bells are the brightest; the rainmaker and clapper are the quietest.Q: Does this make a good gift? A: Yes — it arrives beautifully presented in its own wooden tray, making it a thoughtful, screen-free educational gift for toddlers and preschoolers. It's especially popular for third birthdays, holidays, and grandparent gifts.Q: How do I clean and store the pieces? A: Wipe gently with a soft, slightly damp cloth and dry right away. Each piece has a spot in the wooden tray, making cleanup and shelf storage simple and tidy.

Development Skills at Play Shape recognition — five distinct geometric shapes (circle, rectangle, triangle, square, pentagon) build early shape vocabularyColor recognition and matching — four colors across all five shapes invite natural sorting and namingCounting and one-to-one correspondence — each shape has the matching number of holes (1, 2, 3, 4, 5), so toddlers count as they stackNumber recognition — the ten numbered fish introduce digits 1 through 10 through hands-on playFine motor skills — stacking shapes onto pegs and gripping the fishing rod strengthen little fingersHand-eye coordination — guiding shapes onto the right pegs and casting the magnetic rod build precisionCause and effect — the magnetic fishing rod introduces early STEM thinking through hands-on experimentationProblem solving — figuring out which shape fits which peg column builds early logical thinkingLanguage development — naming shapes, colors, and numbers builds everyday vocabularyConcentration and independent play — five activities in one board support focused, screen-free playtime What's Included 1 × wooden play board with shape-sorter peg columns and slots for the fishing fish4 × wooden circles (each with 1 center hole) in pink, blue, green, and yellow4 × wooden rectangles with 2 holes in pink, blue, green, and yellow4 × wooden triangles with 3 holes in green, yellow, pink, and blue4 × wooden squares with 4 holes in yellow, pink, blue, and green4 × wooden pentagons with 5 holes in pink, blue, green, and yellow10 × numbered magnetic wooden fish (1 through 10) in red, orange, yellow, green, light blue, blue, purple, magenta, pink, and aqua1 × wooden magnetic fishing rod with red string FAQ Q: What age is this shape sorter and fishing board recommended for?A: This set is recommended for children ages 3 years and up. It contains small parts, small magnets, and a corded fishing rod, so it is not suitable for younger toddlers. Close adult supervision is required throughout play.Q: Why is this rated 3+ when similar shape sorters are rated for toddlers?A: The magnetic fishing activity is the reason. Each fish contains a small magnet, and magnets carry a specific ingestion risk that plain wooden shape sorters do not. We grade the whole set to its riskiest component rather than its gentlest, so the 3+ rating reflects the fish and rod, not the shape stacking.Q: What are the magnet safety risks I should know about?A: This is important. If two or more magnets are swallowed, they can attract to one another through the walls of the intestines, pinching the tissue between them. This can cause serious internal injury or death, and it often does not produce obvious symptoms right away. If you suspect a magnet has been swallowed or inhaled, seek immediate medical attention — do not wait for symptoms. Count the fish back into the box after every play session and store the set out of reach of younger children.Q: Is the fishing rod string a hazard?A: The rod has a short attached string. As with any corded toy, it should not be given to babies or young toddlers, and children should not be left unattended with it. Store the rod separately from the board if you have a younger sibling in the house.Q: What's included in the set?A: A wooden play board, 20 wooden geometric shape pieces (4 each of circles, rectangles, triangles, squares, and pentagons in 4 colors), 10 numbered magnetic fish labeled 1 through 10, and a wooden magnetic fishing rod.Q: What does this toy teach?A: Shape recognition, color matching, counting 1 to 10, number recognition, fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, problem solving, and cause-and-effect thinking. The number of holes matches each shape's position in sequence (1 for the circle, 2 for the rectangle, 3 for the triangle, and so on), which introduces counting naturally.Q: How does the magnetic fishing work?A: Each fish has a small metal magnetic top, and the wooden rod has a magnetic end on its string. Children dangle the rod over the fish and the magnet lifts it out of its slot — a satisfying little surprise that builds hand-eye coordination.Q: Does it make a good gift?A: It's a lovely choice for a third or fourth birthday, or for a preschooler starting to work with numbers. For a younger child, we'd point you toward one of our magnet-free wooden shape sorters instead.Q: Does it need batteries?A: No. This is a fully wooden, screen-free toy — no batteries, no electronics, no sounds. Just hands-on discovery.Q: How should I clean it?A: Wipe gently with a soft, damp cloth and dry immediately. Avoid soaking the wooden pieces in water or using harsh chemical cleaners.

products.description: Load the cheerful bunny scale, add the numbered weights, and watch it tip and balance — an inviting first introduction to counting, weighing, and early math. It's a clever pick among Montessori toys for 3 year olds . As a wooden educational toy , it's smooth natural wood with child-safe color and no screens in sight. Balancing the weights teaches numbers, comparison, and cause and effect, while handling the small pieces builds fine motor skills and concentration. A hands-on educational toy for toddlers and preschoolers, it makes abstract math concrete through play. Gift-ready and built to last, it's a thoughtful birthday or holiday present. Adult supervision is recommended, as it contains small parts. Smart play for little growing minds.

Highlights Materials: Solid wood with a smooth sanded finishFinish: Child-safe, water-based paint in a warm carrot gradient (red, orange, yellow) with green carrot tops and natural wood-tone balance beamFormat: Tabletop balance scale with a curved rocker base, pegged stacking columns, and double-sided number flashcardsStacking columns: Multiple pegs on each side of the balance for building carrots of 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 discsFlashcards: Double-sided with digits, written number words, and carrot illustrations to support number recognition and early readingOpen-ended play: No batteries, no sounds — pure hands-on discoverySafety: CPC certified — meets applicable U.S. children's product safety requirements. Always supervise young children to ensure safe, age-appropriate play. Development Skills at Play Early counting and number recognition — matching the numbered carrot tops to the correct number of stacked discs builds the foundation for early mathConcepts of balance and weight — the rocker base introduces equality, comparison, and basic physics through hands-on experimentationAddition and subtraction readiness — kids naturally explore "more than," "less than," and "equal to" as they tip and balance the seesawFine motor skills — stacking the discs onto pegs builds careful hand control and precisionHand-eye coordination — placing each disc accurately on the peg sharpens visual trackingColor recognition — the warm gradient of red, orange, and yellow invites natural color matching and sortingCause and effect — every change in the stack creates a visible reaction in the balance, teaching early STEM thinkingConcentration and patience — careful stacking on the wobble base supports sustained attentionIndependent and screen-free play — a self-correcting toy that grows with your child from simple counting to early math comparison What's Included 1 × wooden balance beam with curved rocker base1 × wooden bunny figure for the center of the balance2 × wooden post pegsA set of wooden stacking discs in a warm carrot gradient (red, red-orange, orange, yellow, and pale yellow tones)Numbered green wooden carrot tops (1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 — two sets, one for each side of the balance)A set of double-sided number flashcards (with digits, number words, and carrot illustrations) FAQ Q: What age is this balance toy recommended for?A: The wooden bunny balance scale is designed for children ages 3 and up. Adult supervision is always recommended for safe, age-appropriate play.Q: What's included in the set?A: The set includes a wooden balance beam with a rocker base, a wooden bunny figure for the center, two wooden post pegs, a set of warm-gradient stacking discs (red, orange, yellow tones), numbered green carrot tops (1 through 5, two sets for both sides), and a set of double-sided number flashcards with digits, number words, and carrot illustrations.Q: What does this toy teach?A: It introduces early math concepts in a hands-on way — counting to 5, number recognition, equality, weight, and comparison. The balance tips when one side is heavier and stays level when both sides are equal, giving kids a visual, physical understanding of "more," "less," and "the same."Q: How do my child and I play with it?A: There are several ways to play. Stack matching numbers on each side and watch the balance stay level. Build a carrot on one side and see how many discs are needed on the other to balance. Use the flashcards to call out a number for your child to build. Or let them experiment freely — every play session teaches something different.Q: How does this toy support my child's development?A: The set is designed to support early counting, number recognition, fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, color recognition, and cause-and-effect thinking. It also lays the foundation for addition, subtraction, and the concept of equality — all through hands-on play.Q: Is it safe for kids?A: Yes. The set is made with smooth sanded wood and child-safe finishes, and is CPC certified to meet applicable U.S. children's product safety requirements. Adult supervision is always recommended.Q: Does it need batteries?A: No. This is a fully wooden, screen-free toy — no batteries, no electronics, no sounds. Just hands-on math discovery.Q: Does it make a good gift?A: Absolutely. With its friendly bunny mascot, multi-mode play, and educational depth, it's a memorable choice for birthdays, holidays, and milestone moments — especially for preschoolers ready to start playing with numbers.Q: How should I clean it?A: Wipe gently with a soft, damp cloth and dry immediately. Avoid soaking the wooden pieces in water or using harsh chemical cleaners.

products.description: Feed the friendly lion, sort by color, and practice that all-important pincer grip. Screen-free and beautifully made, it's an educational toy for toddlers that feels like play, not practice. Gift-ready and built to last, it's a lovely present for a birthday or the holidays. Adult supervision is recommended, as it contains small parts. Smart play for little growing minds.

faqs.question: TinyMind bán đồ chơi gì? Shop có bán theo gói đăng ký hàng tháng không?
faqs.answer: Trong bộ dữ liệu thử nghiệm này, TinyMind dùng catalog JuniSprouts: đồ chơi gỗ lấy cảm hứng Montessori, xếp chồng, phân loại, ghép hình, đóng vai và hoạt động vận động tinh. Khách mua từng món, không subscription hay hộp định kỳ.

faqs.question: Đồ chơi Montessori là gì? Khác đồ chơi thông thường như thế nào?
faqs.answer: Đồ chơi Montessori hướng trẻ tự khám phá và làm một việc rõ ràng như phân loại, xếp hoặc ghép. Thường dùng vật liệu tự nhiên; trẻ chủ động thao tác thay vì chỉ xem đèn hay nghe nhạc tự phát.

faqs.question: Chơi mở open-ended là gì? Cầu vồng gỗ chơi như thế nào?
faqs.answer: Chơi mở không có một đáp án duy nhất. Trẻ có thể dùng các vòm gỗ để làm cầu, đường hầm hoặc cảnh tưởng tượng, tự xếp và thử cách chơi mới.

faqs.question: Đồ chơi phù hợp bé mấy tuổi? Có đồ cho bé 1 tuổi hoặc bé 2 tuổi không?
faqs.answer: Mỗi sản phẩm có tuổi khuyến nghị riêng. Khi chọn cần xem phần Age & Stages và cảnh báo chi tiết nhỏ trên trang chi tiết; một số thẻ sản phẩm hiển thị tuổi thấp hơn phần khuyến nghị. Cần người lớn giám sát khi chơi. Cho shop biết tuổi bé và nhu cầu để chọn đúng món.

faqs.question: Làm sao chọn quà sinh nhật hoặc đồ chơi phát triển kỹ năng cho bé?
faqs.answer: Chọn theo tuổi khuyến nghị của từng món, sở thích và kỹ năng bé đang khám phá: xếp chồng, phân loại màu/hình, ghép hình, đóng vai hoặc vận động tinh. JuniSprouts đóng gói sẵn theo hướng phù hợp làm quà; không cam kết kết quả phát triển cụ thể.

faqs.question: Bé dưới 3 tuổi chơi đồ có hạt nhỏ, bi hoặc nam châm được không?
faqs.answer: Cần đọc đúng tuổi khuyến nghị và cảnh báo của sản phẩm cụ thể. Nhiều bộ có hạt, bi hoặc chi tiết nhỏ ghi chỉ dành cho trẻ từ 3 tuổi, cần giữ xa trẻ nhỏ hơn và có người lớn giám sát. Không chọn món có tuổi khuyến nghị cao hơn tuổi bé.

faqs.question: Làm sao liên hệ hỗ trợ shop JuniSprouts? Có hotline hoặc Zalo không?
faqs.answer: Kênh hỗ trợ công khai là support@junisprouts.com hoặc biểu mẫu Contact tại https://junisprouts.com/pages/contact. Trang Contact ghi phản hồi trong 1–2 ngày làm việc. Chưa xác minh hotline hay Zalo.

faqs.question: Đơn hàng của tôi ở đâu? Có mã vận đơn tracking không?
faqs.answer: Sau khi gửi hàng, JuniSprouts gửi email xác nhận kèm tracking. Nếu quá 24 giờ từ lúc đặt chưa thấy email gửi hàng, kiểm tra thư rác rồi liên hệ support@junisprouts.com. Bot chưa được kết nối tra cứu đơn thực tế nên không tự tạo trạng thái hay mã vận đơn.

faqs.question: Hàng bị hỏng, thiếu hoặc giao sai thì làm gì?
faqs.answer: Với hàng hỏng, lỗi hoặc giao sai, email support@junisprouts.com trong 30 ngày kèm ảnh để hỗ trợ kiểm tra. Không tự gửi trả trước khi nhận hướng dẫn. Chưa có thông tin xác nhận cách xử lý hàng thiếu nên cần hỗ trợ kiểm tra theo mã đơn.

faqs.question: Shop có giao đến Việt Nam hoặc giao quốc tế không?
faqs.answer: Theo chính sách vận chuyển hiện công bố, JuniSprouts chỉ giao trong 50 bang Hoa Kỳ và chưa giao quốc tế. Website hiển thị VND không đồng nghĩa với việc nhận giao đến Việt Nam.

faqs.question: Vì sao giá trên website của tôi là VND nhưng phí ship trong chính sách là USD?
faqs.answer: Phiên website dùng để chuẩn bị dữ liệu ngày 2026-10-29 hiển thị catalog VND, được xác nhận từ trang sản phẩm và currency của giỏ hàng. Trang chính sách vận chuyển vẫn ghi USD. Chưa có mức phí ship VND được xác minh; tổng phải trả cần kiểm tra tại checkout hoặc với chủ shop.

faqs.question: Shop cho đổi trả trong 60 hay 90 ngày?
faqs.answer: Trang chính sách Refund & Returns riêng hiện ghi 60 ngày từ khi nhận hàng. Một số trang sản phẩm còn đoạn 90 ngày mâu thuẫn. Bộ dữ liệu đang dùng chính sách riêng 60 ngày; trường hợp cần áp dụng khác phải được chủ shop xác nhận.

scenarios.title: Tư vấn theo tuổi và nhu cầu
scenarios.trigger: Khách hỏi mua quà hoặc chưa biết chọn món
scenarios.content: Hỏi tuổi bé và mục đích chơi; nếu cần hỏi thêm ngân sách. Chỉ gợi ý món có trong dữ liệu, phù hợp tuổi khuyến nghị chi tiết. Không gợi ý đồ có chi tiết nhỏ cho bé dưới tuổi khuyến nghị.

scenarios.title: Báo giá theo biến thể
scenarios.trigger: Khách hỏi giá hoặc so sánh sản phẩm
scenarios.content: Dùng giá VND đã nhập của đúng biến thể. Với bộ thực phẩm có nhiều biến thể, hỏi khách chọn loại hoặc liệt kê giá từng loại; không dùng giá thấp nhất cho mọi bộ. Không tự chuyển đổi USD/VND, áp mã hay hứa giảm thêm.

scenarios.title: Xác nhận tồn kho
scenarios.trigger: Khách hỏi còn hàng, số lượng hoặc giữ hàng
scenarios.content: Đây là bộ dữ liệu mẫu để thử tạo đơn. Dùng số Có thể bán hiện tại trong catalog của ứng dụng, theo đúng biến thể khách chọn. Không dùng tình trạng còn/hết hàng trong snapshot website để phủ nhận tồn kho demo đã được chủ shop thiết lập. Khi số Có thể bán không đủ, nói rõ và xin chủ shop kiểm tra; không hứa giữ hàng, giao hàng hoặc tạo đơn trước khi thao tác thành công. Không giới thiệu tồn kho demo là tồn kho thật của JuniSprouts.

scenarios.title: Khách muốn đặt hàng
scenarios.trigger: Khách đồng ý mua hoặc yêu cầu chốt đơn
scenarios.content: Tóm tắt sản phẩm, biến thể và số lượng khách chọn. Chỉ xin thông tin còn thiếu cần cho chủ shop xác nhận. Chưa có action tạo đơn thành công thì không nói đã tạo đơn, trừ tiền, đặt ship hoặc đã giữ hàng. Phí ship và địa chỉ giao theo chính sách nguồn cần được xác minh.

scenarios.title: Giao hàng ngoài Mỹ
scenarios.trigger: Khách muốn giao Việt Nam hoặc nước khác ngoài Hoa Kỳ
scenarios.content: Nói rõ chính sách hiện chỉ giao trong Hoa Kỳ, chưa giao quốc tế; không hứa COD, giao Việt Nam hoặc tự đặt phí vận chuyển.

scenarios.title: Đổi trả và khiếu nại
scenarios.trigger: Khách báo hỏng, giao sai hoặc muốn đổi trả
scenarios.content: Xin mã đơn và mô tả ngắn; hướng dẫn kênh hỗ trợ trong hồ sơ. Dùng chính sách riêng thay vì đoạn mâu thuẫn trong trang sản phẩm. Không tự xác nhận hoàn tiền hoặc bảo đảm đổi mới.

scenarios.title: Thiếu dữ liệu hoặc yêu cầu gặp chủ shop
scenarios.trigger: Khách cần thông tin chưa có hoặc muốn nhân viên hỗ trợ
scenarios.content: Nói rõ thông tin nào chưa được xác nhận; dùng luồng chuyển người thật khi khách yêu cầu. Không bịa hotline, địa chỉ nhận trực tiếp, phương thức thanh toán hay thời hạn bảo hành.

scenarios.title: Sau khi chốt đơn
scenarios.trigger: Chủ shop hoặc action đã xác nhận tạo đơn thành công
scenarios.content: Cảm ơn ngắn gọn theo kết quả xác nhận thực tế. Không tự thêm ngày giao, trạng thái thanh toán hoặc mã vận đơn.

quickReplies.title: tuoi-be
quickReplies.content: Dạ anh/chị đang tìm đồ chơi cho bé bao nhiêu tuổi và thích hoạt động nào ạ?

quickReplies.title: chon-bo
quickReplies.content: Dạ anh/chị chọn bộ/biến thể nào và số lượng bao nhiêu để shop kiểm tra chính xác ạ?

quickReplies.title: tra-don
quickReplies.content: Dạ anh/chị gửi giúp shop mã đơn và vấn đề cần hỗ trợ; nhân viên sẽ kiểm tra trạng thái thực tế ạ.

quickReplies.title: ho-tro
quickReplies.content: Anh/chị có thể gửi mã đơn và ảnh vấn đề đến support@junisprouts.com. Vui lòng chờ hướng dẫn trước khi gửi trả hàng ạ.
